Welcome.title: Welcome to the official website of the organization
Welcome.body:
Welcome to the official website of the Mauritanian Organization for the Defense of Human Rights and Human Development (OMDHD).

We are an independent civil organization working to promote and protect human rights and to anchor the principles of justice, equality and human dignity. We also support sustainable human development, the empowerment of the most vulnerable groups, and the building of a cohesive society founded on citizenship, solidarity and respect for fundamental rights and freedoms.

Through our programs, initiatives and national and international partnerships, we spread rights awareness, strengthen the capacities of youth and women, address community development issues, and contribute to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals in Mauritania.

AboutPage.title: An organization born of a deep belief in dignity
AboutPage.intro: The Mauritanian Organization for the Defense of Human Rights and Human Development (OMDHD) is an independent non-governmental organization, founded on the firm belief that respect for human rights and the promotion of human development are two essential pillars of stability, progress and prosperity.
AboutPage.storyBody: The organization was born from the conviction that protecting rights and building humanity are inseparable. Since its founding, it has combined rights advocacy with grassroots development work, acting as a bridge between communities and decision-makers, and a voice for those who have none.
AboutPage.approachBody: We adopt a participatory approach that places people at the heart of every intervention, starts from the real needs of communities, and builds on partnership, transparency and accountability.
AboutPage.pillar1Text: Protecting fundamental rights and freedoms and anchoring the rule of law.
AboutPage.pillar2Text: Building the capacities of individuals and communities and supporting education.
AboutPage.pillar3Text: Empowering women and youth and strengthening their active participation.

VisionPage.title: Toward a society of justice and dignity
VisionPage.statement: A Mauritanian society where everyone enjoys their fundamental rights and actively participates in the development of their country, in justice, equality and the rule of law.
VisionPage.p1Text: Equal rights for all, without discrimination, in full respect of the rule of law.
VisionPage.p2Text: Engaged citizens who shape the future of their country with confidence and responsibility.
VisionPage.p3Text: Balanced human progress that preserves dignity and invests in future generations.

MissionPage.title: What we work for every day
MissionPage.statement: Defending human rights, advancing human development, and empowering target groups through awareness, training, advocacy and community partnership.
MissionPage.m1: Defend human rights and protect fundamental freedoms.
MissionPage.m2: Advance sustainable and inclusive human development.
MissionPage.m3: Empower women, youth and target groups.
MissionPage.m4: Raise awareness, train, advocate and build partnerships.

ValuesPage.title: Principles that guide everything we do
ValuesPage.subtitle: Solid values that form the compass of our work and guarantee our integrity and independence toward society and partners.
ValuesPage.v1Text: A free, autonomous decision, away from any dependency or influence.
ValuesPage.v2Text: Honesty and ethical commitment in all our interventions.
ValuesPage.v3Text: Clarity and accountability in management, resources and results.
ValuesPage.v4Text: Fairness that ensures rights reach those entitled to them.
ValuesPage.v5Text: Equal opportunity and dignity, without any discrimination.
ValuesPage.v6Text: People as an end, never a means, in everything we do.
ValuesPage.v7Text: A lasting commitment toward society and future generations.
